basics.name: Joonas Lehtinen
basics.label: Senior Front-End Developer and Partner
basics.summary: Joonas is a senior front-end developer, UI designer, and accessibility specialist. With his understanding of usability and visual design, he serves as a bridge between these two areas of expertise. In his current project, Joonas holds the title of Lead Developer, where his responsibilities include providing guidance related to React, TypeScript, and CSS. Additionally, he has served as an instructor teaching frontend technologies to career changers and has delivered numerous presentations on accessibility targeted at both developers and content creators. Joonas is consistently recognized for his exceptional work in usability and accessibility.
basics.x-tagline: Ask yourself whether motion in a user interface helps people spot what matters, or makes it harder for them to focus on everything else.

x-keySkills.title: Accessibility
x-keySkills.description: Joonas understands what it takes to make services genuinely usable with assistive technology, going beyond merely meeting minimum criteria. He also has experience conducting accessibility audits.

x-keySkills.title: Usability
x-keySkills.description: Static design visuals are never the final product. Joonas's greatest strengths include making design decisions that translate effectively into the browser.

x-keySkills.title: Eye for detail
x-keySkills.description: Joonas has an excellent eye for creating visually polished interfaces and crafting animations that feel just right.

x-keySkills.title: Team skills
x-keySkills.description: Joonas communicates effectively with fellow developers and excels at understanding stakeholders' needs.

x-keyRoles.title: Lead Front-end Developer, Kustannus Kirjava
x-keyRoles.description: At Kustannus Kirjava, Joonas has been developing an online education platform for pupils and teachers. The product includes a complex set of UI patterns designed to be accessible even for users relying on assistive technology.

x-keyRoles.title: Front-end Developer and UI Designer, Merivoima Oyj
x-keyRoles.description: Merivoima Oyj collects enormous amounts of data from their engines used in vessels and power plants around the globe. Joonas's role involved designing and implementing various interfaces that enabled the company's experts to monitor this data through interactive infographics.

x-keyRoles.title: Accessibility Consultant
x-keyRoles.description: Joonas has conducted accessibility audits for various clients and delivered presentations on accessibility for developers and content creators.

All features are implemented to meet WCAG 2.2 accessibility standards.

projects.name: Tool Repair Portal
projects.description: The client's Tool Repair Portal is a React web application for managing tools sent to repair centers worldwide. Joonas led the project's design phase, wireframing each step of the repair workflow. During this period, Joonas successfully drove the frontend development, exceeding expectations. He enhanced responsive design, improved user satisfaction, collaborated effectively across teams, and contributed valuable insights in knowledge-sharing sessions.
